segments.he: גְּמָ׳ הָא לְעִנְיַן כֵּלִים שֶׁעוֹשִׂין בָּהֶן אוֹכֶל נֶפֶשׁ — זֶה וָזֶה שָׁוִין.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara infers «that with regard to the matter of utensils that one uses» in «preparation of food,» both «this,» one who vowed that any benefit is forbidden, «and that,» one who vowed that benefit from food is forbidden, «are equal.» It is prohibited for both to derive benefit from utensils used in the preparation of food.

moves.cueHe: הא לענין כלים שעושין בהן אוכל נפש

edges.about: the mishna implies both vowers are forbidden food-preparation utensils

positions.claim: utensils used for food preparation are forbidden to both
